adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(SDL3_shadercross CONFIG REQUIRED) and links SDL3_shadercross::SDL3_shadercross; its header is <SDL3_shadercross/SDL_shadercross.h>.

Setup glue calls SDL_ShaderCross_Init in the systems phase and SDL_ShaderCross_Quit at shutdown; the sdl-shadercross--sdl3 pairing compiles shaders for the composition's SDL_GPU device, and the assets binding cooks shader files at build time.
